test_title: PYST 21: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Her dedication to her work was _______ what anyone had expected.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct preposition to use in this context is **'beyond'**, which means** 'at or to the further side of**' or** 'more than'.**
 
• The sentence implies that **her dedication exceeded the expectations, and 'beyond' appropriately conveys this meaning.**
 
• The correct preposition here is **'beyond.'**

Hence, the correct statement is** '*Her dedication to her work was beyond__ what anyone had expected*.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 'over'** implies **movement, direction, or position **but** does not** fit the context of exceeding expectations.
 
• **Option 3 'beside' **means **next to,** which is spatial and **not suitable** for this context.
 
• **Option 4 'through' **suggests** moving in one side and out the other**, which **does not convey** the intended meaning of exceeding.
